about: A chip of BN5's that BN6's code plays (issue #82's C1, judged by its C2): BN5's CanladEX held paralysed (hold: each game's own status step, the same bits in both) at (4,2), MegaMan with a folder of Z Saver Z in both games, BN5's chip 218 by BN5's own code and the registry's 294 by BN6's (the Z Saver pseudo-chip's family 0x5B) under BN5's record, the first Custom screen's chip picked and OK, used at t30: every difference of BN6's play from BN5's is the chip's (docs/MULTIROM.md, The chip registry).
subject: megaman

verdict.why: BN6's Z Saver family (0x5B, its pseudo-chip's), which the registry's Z Saver plays, slashes as BN5's (0x34) does, three times for 100, each a frame sooner (BN5's slashes at t35, t57, t79; BN6's at t34, t56, t78), and sets MegaMan's collision data +0x3E bit 0x40 and his AI data +0xE0 to 3 as it starts, which BN5's does not; BN5's family moved waits for a helper BN6 has no twin of (0x08012530), its sprite (list 3's 0x14) and its flash's number (docs/MULTIROM.md, The chips' code)
